children: Braze, Inc. reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $227.23M, up 26.2% from $180.11M a year earlier, and a net loss of ($18.85M) versus ($27.9M) in the prior-year quarter; diluted loss per share was ($0.17) compared with ($0.26) a year ago.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributable to Braze, Inc.”. ³ Reported as “loss per share attributable to Braze, Inc. common stockholders, basic and diluted”.
Revenue growth was driven by expansion within existing customers, which accounted for roughly 55–63% of the increase.
Shift toward premium messaging channels raised third‑party messaging fees and platform compute requirements.
Customer count grew to 2,789 with monthly active users near 9.0B and dollar‑based net retention around 110–112%, supporting upsell momentum.
Company increased R&D and go‑to‑market headcount and invested in infrastructure to support global expansion and AI capabilities.
Positive operating cash flow and higher free cash flow funded investments and an accelerated share repurchase program.
